debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d f-a-c-t-i-t-i-o-u-s g-p-s c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-s f-o-r n-o-n-e-x-i-s-t-e-n-t r-e-f-o-r-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n s-i-t-e-s, l-e-f-t s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t-s w-i-t-h i-n-v-e-n-t-e-d l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d s-i-t-e v-i-s-i-t-s
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e i-m-a-g-e-e-x-t-r-a-c-t-s s-h-o-w-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e v-e-g-e-t-a-t-i-o-n g-r-o-w-t-h, l-e-f-t i-m-a-g-e f-i-l-e-s w-i-t-h m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d t-e-m-p-o-r-a-l m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-m-o-t-e s-e-n-s-i-n-g
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t-s a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-n-g c-a-r-b-o-n s-t-o-r-a-g-e t-o g-h-o-s-t p-l-o-t-s, l-e-f-t s-i-g-n-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-i-t-h s-h-r-o-u-d i-s-s-u-e d-a-t-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-e-p-s
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-v-e-l-o-p-e-d a s-a-l-e-s n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e a-l-l-e-g-i-n-g c-e-r-t-i-f-i-e-d o-f-f-s-e-t p-r-o-j-e-c-t-s, l-e-f-t p-r-o-p-o-s-a-l d-e-c-k-s c-i-t-i-n-g u-n-d-e-r-l-y-i-n-g f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d s-u-p-p-o-r-t i-n-g c-o-m-m-u-n-i-t-y t-e-s-t-i-m-o-n-y f-r-o-m u-n-e-x-i-s-t-i-n-g s-t-a-k-e-h-o-l-d-e-r-s, l-e-f-t t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t-s w-i-t-h f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-i-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d b-e-n-c-h-m-a-r-k-i-n-g a-g-a-i-n-s-t a-c-c-e-p-t-e-d s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s
